questions.question: When do API credentials expire?
What is the process for replacing an API key?
questions.expected_answer: Create a replacement, update clients, and revoke the old key.

questions.question: How many API calls can a workspace make each minute?
How should clients handle HTTP 429?
questions.expected_answer: Wait for the Retry-After delay and use exponential backoff.

questions.question: How frequently are database backups taken?
Does a restore replace my current database?
questions.expected_answer: No. A restore creates a new database without overwriting the original.

questions.question: When are monthly invoices sent?
questions.expected_answer: On the first day of each month for the previous month of usage.

questions.question: How long is the grace period after a payment fails?
How long are standard application event logs kept?
How long are audit records stored?
How soon will an updated document appear in search?
questions.expected_answer: On the next index refresh, which runs every five minutes.

questions.question: What is the largest source document accepted for indexing?
What happens when a new release fails its health check?
questions.expected_answer: An automatic rollback restores the previous release.

questions.question: How long can a deployment health check run before timing out?
What is the initial response target for a critical production incident?
What information should I attach to a support ticket?
questions.expected_answer: A request ID, timestamp, and reproduction steps.

questions.question: In what format will I receive an export?
When does an export download link stop working?
Which encryption protects stored customer data?
What is the minimum TLS version for network connections?
How long does an interactive login session last?
Can I reuse a password reset link?
questions.expected_answer: No. It can be used only once and expires after 30 minutes.

questions.question: Can I change an existing workspace to a different region?
questions.expected_answer: No. Export the data and import it into a new workspace in the target region.

questions.question: Is regional failover automatic?
questions.expected_answer: No. It is a manual operation coordinated with support.

questions.question: How do database backup and application event-log retention differ?
questions.expected_answer: Database backups are kept for 14 days and standard application event logs for 30 days.

questions.question: How do API key expiration and interactive session expiration differ?
questions.expected_answer: API keys expire after 90 days; interactive sessions expire after eight hours.

questions.question: How can I move a workspace to another region and what export format should I expect?
questions.expected_answer: Export data and import it into a new workspace in the target region. Exports are gzip-compressed JSON Lines.
